task_production_rates.name: Install localized floor protection around spray work area
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Canvas drop cloths around discrete element work areas. Floor-level work — no overhead penalty. Localized protection (not full room). Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Install perimeter floor protection near work area
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Drop cloth runners near element work areas. Floor-level work. Brush only.

task_production_rates.name: Mask wall surfaces adjacent to elements
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Tape + masking paper/film at beam-wall, column-wall, and mantel-wall junctions. Working at various heights. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Mask ceiling fixtures near beam spray work
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Tape and plastic bag over each ceiling fixture. Overhead work near beam spray zone. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Dust and clean all element surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. Tack cloth or damp wipe all beam, column, and mantel surfaces. Mixed heights — beams overhead, columns full-height, mantels wall-height. Time scales with element count but FIXED per room is reasonable for typical 1-3 elements per room.

task_production_rates.name: Sand beam surfaces per substrate and state
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Overhead work on ceiling-mounted beams. 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides). SS_BARE: 150-220 grit, ~0.85x of equivalent trim rates. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: lighter scuff sand. Apply beam_profile complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Sand column surfaces per substrate and state
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on 8ft square_smooth column (baseline). 4 flat faces, full height — ladder needed for upper portion. Fluted columns: flexible sanding sponge in channels. Apply column_type complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Sand mantel surfaces per substrate and state
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on standard_surround (baseline). Shelf, legs/pilasters, and surround molding. Wall height (H1). Detail profiles require flexible sanding approach. Apply mantel_type complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on beams

QT3.notes: Fill obvious holes at miters and assembly fasteners

QT4.notes: Fill all visible holes, sand flush 220 grit

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, sand flush 220+ grit, angled light check

task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. qt_scaled. Overhead work. Beam miters and assembly fasteners. Apply beam_profile complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on columns

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, perfect flush, angled light check

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Based on 8ft square_smooth column. Panel joints and assembly fasteners. Full height work. Apply column_type complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on mantels

QT4.notes: Fill all visible holes, profile detail checked

QT5.notes: Fill every hole, perfect flush on all surfaces, angled light check

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Based on standard_surround. Shelf-to-leg joints, leg-to-wall fasteners, molding joints. Wall height. Apply mantel_type complexity modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk beam-to-structure junctions
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Beam-to-ceiling junction full length (both sides = ~2 LF caulk per 1 LF beam), plus miter joints at beam intersections. Overhead work. Use flexible painter's caulk for movement-prone junctions. Apply beam_profile modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk column-to-structure junctions
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on 8ft square_smooth column. Top perimeter + bottom perimeter + back edge (wall-mounted). Significant caulk per column — full perimeter at top and bottom is ~8 LF+ each. Apply column_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk mantel-to-wall junctions
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on standard_surround. Mantel-to-wall all contact edges, shelf-to-leg joints, leg-to-wall junctions. full_assembly has significantly more junction LF (1.50x modifier). Apply mantel_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Seal MDF cut/routed edges (solvent-based)
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. All MDF elements — beam miters, column panel joints, mantel shelf edges, leg edges. Shellac/oil-based sealer applied by small brush to each cut/routed edge. MANDATORY step 1 of MDF two-step prime. NON-NEGOTIABLE. Conditional: substrate=MDF AND substrate_state=SS_BARE. Time depends on element count and complexity.

task_production_rates.name: Prime beam surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Full primer coat, multi-angle passes for 3-sided coverage. Overhead work ~0.85x of equivalent trim rates. Primer type driven by substrate (MDF step 2 latex, FJP stain-block, hardwood tannin-block, softwood acrylic). Apply beam_profile modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Prime column surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on 8ft square_smooth column. Full coat top-to-bottom. Height modifier applies — upper portion requires ladder. Apply column_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Prime mantel surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on standard_surround. Shelf, legs/pilasters, surround detail. Wall height (H1 typical). Apply mantel_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on beams
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Multiple angle spray passes for 3-sided beam coverage. Bottom face first (overhead), then side faces. Lighter coats on bottom to prevent sags. Overhead factor ~0.85x of equiv. trim rate baked in. Apply beam_profile modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on columns
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on 8ft square_smooth column. Rotate around column with consistent overlap, top-to-bottom. Fluted: angle spray into channels. Round: continuous rotation. Thin coats on vertical faces. Apply column_type modifier. Height modifier stacks.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on mantels
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on standard_surround. Detail profiles first (recessed areas, molding), then flat faces (shelf top, leg fronts). Wall height. Apply mantel_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on beams
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Work face-by-face. Bottom (overhead) hardest — load brush lighter. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). Ornate profiles require detail brush. Overhead factor ~0.85x baked in. Apply beam_profile modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on columns
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on 8ft square_smooth column. Square: Roll and Tip on flat faces per FFD SS15.6. Round/fluted: brush only, follow profile. Top-to-bottom. Apply column_type modifier. Height modifier stacks.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on mantels
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Based on standard_surround. Shelf: Roll and Tip on flat top. Legs/pilasters: brush with grain. Molding detail: small angled brush. Apply, tip once, walk away. Apply mantel_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Clean work area between coats
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Floor-level cleanup — remove dust and debris from protection and surrounding area.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect previous coat on all elements
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Inspect all elements in one pass. QT3: quick scan for obvious defects. QT4: systematic 3-foot inspection, mark defects. QT5: lighted critical inspection at arm's length, zero tolerance. Check beam undersides for sags, column vertical for runs, mantel shelf edges for drips.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on beams
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. qt_scaled. Per interstage cycle. Overhead sanding on ceiling-mounted beams. Rigid block on flat faces (FFD SS15.4.1). Apply beam_profile modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on columns
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Per interstage cycle. Full height — ladder for upper portion. Fluted: flexible sanding sponge. Apply column_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on mantels

QT5.notes: Thorough 220-320 grit, uniform scratch, angled light check

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. qt_scaled. Per interstage cycle. Wall height. Molding detail requires flexible sanding approach. Apply mantel_type modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Patch and repair marked defects
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Fill, sand, and spot-prime defects found during inspection. Scope increases with tier. Mixed heights — beam patches overhead, column patches at height, mantel patches at wall height.

task_production_rates.name: Spot coat patched areas
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. qt_scaled. Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish before next full coat.

task_production_rates.name: Tack cloth all element surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth. Cover every surface — work into profile detail. Mixed heights.

task_production_rates.name: Final quality inspection of all elements
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. qt_scaled. Inspect all elements. Key checkpoints: beam underside sags, column run marks, mantel shelf edge drips, caulk line quality, sheen uniformity, profile detail coverage. QT5: angled light on all faces, zero tolerance.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-up defects found during final inspection
task_production_rates.notes: Per room. qt_scaled. Correct remaining defects, feather into surrounding finish. QT5 may require full additional coat if defects are widespread.

task_production_rates.name: Remove wall adjacent masking
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Score tape edge before removal, pull at 45-degree angle. Faster than setup (80 LF/hr) — removal is simpler. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove fixture masking
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. Remove tape and plastic from ceiling fixtures. Clean adhesive residue. Faster than setup. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove floor protection
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Floor-level work. Fold canvas/paper inward to contain debris. Covers both workzone (spray) and perimeter (brush) removal.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum work area
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. Floor-level work. Vacuum floor area after protection removal.

task_production_rates.name: Clean tools and equipment
task_production_rates.notes: Per session. Clean brushes, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Water cleanup for waterborne products. Solvent cleanup for shellac-based MDF edge sealer residue.

H1_STANDARD.description: Standard ceiling height. Step ladder for overhead beam work. Standing work for columns and mantels.

H2_STEP.description: Taller step ladder. Beams harder overhead. Columns need larger ladder for top.

H3_EXT.description: Extension ladder or scaffold. Beams require scaffold platform. Tall columns require repositioning.

H4_SCAFFOLD.description: Full scaffold. Significant access setup. Beams at cathedral ceiling height.

height_modifiers.application_rule: Engine applies height modifier per room via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND. NOT embedded in base rates. effective_rate = base_rate / height_modifier. Applies to ALL beam tasks (overhead) and ALL column tasks (full-height). Mantel tasks typically H1 but engine can override if mantel is at unusual height (overmantel, etc.).
height_modifiers.notes: Height modifiers from Modifier_Registry v1.2. Beam overhead penalty (~0.85x of trim rates) is BAKED INTO base rates. Height modifier stacks ON TOP of overhead penalty for beams. For columns, height modifier is the primary access factor — no separate overhead penalty.

quality_tier_modifiers.does_not_apply_to: binary tasks — application (prime, spray, brush) quality is NOT tiered; protection and cleanup tasks
quality_tier_modifiers.application_rule: Modifiers increase TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. QT modifiers apply ONLY to qt_scaled tasks (fill, interstage sand, inspect, patch, spot coat, touchup, final inspect).

beam_profile.source: Research CD-004, adapted from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine SS7.2
beam_profile.application_rule: Modifiers increase TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / beam_profile_modifier. small_box=narrow flat faces (4-6 in), standard_box=typical decorative (6-8 in), large_timber=heavy timber (10+ in), ornate=carved/detailed profile.
beam_profile.notes: Beam profile modifier is scoped to BEAM TASKS ONLY. Does NOT affect column, mantel, or room-level tasks.

column_type.source: Research CD-005, adapted from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine SS7.2
column_type.application_rule: Modifiers increase TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / column_type_modifier. square_smooth=flat panel faces, square_detailed=panel with applied molding/pilaster detail, round_smooth=turned or wrapped cylinder, round_fluted=fluted with channel detail.
column_type.notes: Column type modifier is scoped to COLUMN TASKS ONLY. Does NOT affect beam, mantel, or room-level tasks.

mantel_type.source: Research CD-006, adapted from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine SS7.2
mantel_type.application_rule: Modifiers increase TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / mantel_type_modifier. shelf_only=single floating shelf, standard_surround=shelf + legs/pilasters framing firebox, full_assembly=elaborate surround with crown/dentil/paneling.
mantel_type.notes: Mantel type modifier is scoped to MANTEL TASKS ONLY. full_assembly (1.50x) may not capture the most complex installations — flag for individual assessment per UNC-002.

estimation_notes.three_element_architecture: This spec has 3 paintable items with different UOMs: beam (LF), column (EA), mantel (EA). Per-element tasks exist where production rate depends on element geometry. Shared FIXED tasks handle room-level work (dust clean, interstage cycle tasks, cleanup). Engine runs each element's tasks against its own quantity input.
estimation_notes.overhead_factor: Beam tasks have ~0.85x overhead penalty baked into base rates (less severe than full ceiling 0.70-0.80x because beams are discrete elements with accessible faces). This is NOT a separate modifier — it's embedded in the rates. Height modifier stacks ON TOP of this.
estimation_notes.element_complexity: Three separate complexity modifiers, each scoped to its own element type: beam_profile (1.0-1.40x), column_type (1.0-1.30x), mantel_type (1.0-1.50x). These never cross-apply.
estimation_notes.height_impact: Height modifier applies to beam tasks (always overhead) and column tasks (full-height). Mantels are typically H1 (wall height). Combined example: large_timber beam at H3 = 150 LF/hr spray / 1.20 (large_timber) / 1.50 (H3) = ~83 LF/hr.
estimation_notes.spray_vs_brush: Spray is ~2.0-2.5x faster than brush for these elements. Beam: 150 vs 60 LF/hr. Column: 5 vs 2.5 EA/hr. Mantel: 2.5 vs 1.5 EA/hr.
estimation_notes.no_dry_times: Per RC-004: no dry times specified. Refer to manufacturer PDS.
estimation_notes.caulk_note: Architectural elements have high caulk density relative to their surface area — beam junctions, column top/bottom perimeters, mantel contact edges. Caulk labor is a significant portion of prep.
estimation_notes.full_assembly_warning: Per UNC-002: full_assembly mantels (1.50x) vary enormously. Installations exceeding typical scope should be assessed individually.

assumptions.value: 150 LF/hr for beam spray finish at standard_box baseline
assumptions.source: Research RF-006 guidance (130-170 LF/hr) — midpoint selected
assumptions.note: No doctrine provides beam-specific LF spray rates. Research extrapolated from trim rates with ~0.85x overhead factor.

assumptions.value: 60 LF/hr for beam brush finish at standard_box baseline
assumptions.source: Research RF-006 guidance (50-70 LF/hr) — midpoint selected
assumptions.note: Brush overhead is more fatiguing than spray overhead. Rate is ~0.40x of spray rate.

assumptions.value: 5 EA/hr for column spray finish at square_smooth baseline (8ft)
assumptions.note: No doctrine covers column-specific EA spray rates. Estimated from equivalent trim SF per column.

assumptions.value: 2.5 EA/hr for column brush finish at square_smooth baseline (8ft)
assumptions.note: Square columns use Roll and Tip per FFD SS15.6 on flat faces — faster than full brush.

assumptions.value: 2.5 EA/hr for mantel spray finish at standard_surround baseline
assumptions.note: Mantel rates highly variable by assembly complexity. standard_surround is baseline. full_assembly uses 1.50x modifier.

assumptions.value: 1.5 EA/hr for mantel brush finish at standard_surround baseline
assumptions.note: Mantel brush is the slowest task in this spec. Detail molding requires small angled brush. shelf_only would be ~2-3 EA/hr.

assumptions.value: 0.85x of equivalent trim rates for ceiling-mounted beams
assumptions.source: Research RF-006 — less than full ceiling (0.70-0.80x) because beams are discrete elements
assumptions.note: No doctrine provides explicit beam overhead penalty. Field calibration recommended. Discrete beam overhead is less severe than continuous ceiling.

assumptions.source: Research CD-004/005/006, adapted from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine SS7.2
assumptions.note: These modifiers are research-based adaptations. No doctrine explicitly covers architectural element complexity categories.
Standard height modifiers from doctrine. Apply to beam and column tasks. Mantel typically H1.
